body.enUS:
This site is made of the content of the CMS: every page you see was rendered by PageHelper from a Mustache template.

What is in it

  • Articles an editor writes in the admin
  • Templates that live in the project
  • Pages that are kept until something changes

title.enUS: Why the templates have no code

body.enUS: Mustache templates only print what they are given. The loader of a route prepares the data, so a designer can edit a template without being able to break the server.

title.enUS: A short guide to the kept pages

body.enUS: A page is kept after it is made. It is made again when a template file changes, when a record it read is updated, or when it gets too old.
Pages, a 404 page and an error page, all of them templates of your own.
